messages:
nina: Heads-up — during the 11:00 change window the kv-cache rollout is showing a small but sustained p95 deviation (~270ms) and a tiny 5xx bump in eu-west. Noticed at ~25% traffic. Can we hold traffic or pin back?

deploy-bot: Deploy start: kv-cache v2.14 -> v2.15 (canary 25%) by maria. Rollout id: r-2026-03-20-1223

slo-bot: ALERT: kv-cache.p95_latency (eu-west) breached warning threshold. Current p95=272ms (SLO target 200ms). 5xx rate increased: 0.9% (baseline 0.1%). 1m/5m windows.

alex: thanks nina. Any error traces yet? stack or client-side timeouts?

maria: no obvious tracegroup spike. Logs show a few handler timeouts on node-3 during higher load. Dumping recent logs:
```
[2026-03-20T11:02:13Z] handler timeout getPrefix KVC-3 502
[2026-03-20T11:02:15Z] kv-evict miss count jump +120
```

jonathan: could be a GC/quantization artifact — v2.15 has the new kv-prefetch flag. If it's causing tail-latency under certain seq-len, pin makes sense.

nina: suggestion: pause rollout and pin to v2.14 while we triage. Who can run the pin? ops-runner? @alex?

alex: I can run pin. Proposed command: `redwoodctl rollout pin --service=kv-cache --rollout=r-2026-03-20-1223 --to-rev=v2.14 --reason="p95 bump in canary"`

maria: Wait 2 mins — can we gather a single-request replay of the failing trace first? If it's a narrow input distribution we could fix fast without full rollback.

nina: we have ~45s of elevated errors already. My call is pause+pin; the customer-facing error rate will climb otherwise. Ops prefers conservative.

ops-runner: On it — pausing rollout now. deploy-bot: execute pause command.

deploy-bot: Rollout r-2026-03-20-1223 paused at 25%.

alex: running pin now. `redwoodctl rollout pin --service=kv-cache --to-rev=v2.14 --rollout=r-2026-03-20-1223`

alex: done — pinned. Traffic reverted to v2.14 for all nodes in eu-west. Waiting for SLOs to normalize.

slo-bot: UPDATE: kv-cache.p95_latency (eu-west) returning: p95=195ms, 5xx=0.12% over 1m window.

maria: thanks all. We'll extract failing request inputs and run postmortem test against v2.15 in staging. Will follow up with a short changelog note.

nina: good recovery. For release notes: mark v2.15 as "paused due to kv-prefetch tail latency; investigating quantization path" and schedule follow-up canary when fixed.

jonathan: I can reproduce a tail case locally — sending repro script in #eng-ml shortly.

maria: assign follow-up task: ENG-1429. I'll add triage notes and link to logs.

nina: closing thread — thanks.

(reacts: :thumbsup: from alex, :eyes: from jonathan)
